chunks: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will protect them from the torment of Hell.

key_terms.الْمَوْتَةَ الْأُولَىٰ: The first death (death in this worldly life)

ai.seo_question: What does the 'first death' mean in the context of Paradise?
ai.summary: This verse highlights the concept of 'Al-Mawtata al-Ula' (the first death), signifying that the blessed have already undergone the transition from worldly life to the grave, thereby sparing them the finality of death in the Hereafter. Shia scholars emphasize this as a divine mercy, ensuring that the faithful are protected from the recurring trials of death and the eternal torment of Hellfire, securing their permanent abode in Paradise.
